company.description: We're pioneering a new kind of medical facility to complement virtual primary care. We provide diagnostics, nursing services, point-of-care testing, phlebotomy, and more at transparent cash prices. Our goal is to bridge the gap in care quality and scope that exists between telemedicine and in-person care.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,567,636 to $2,567,636, a 1x increase.
